summary: LLM-as-judge research (2026: calibration probes arXiv:2512.22245, judge blind-spots arXiv:2606.10315) finds judges have LOW error-detection recall and systematic overconfidence — validating our gate-outranks-narrative policy. Our verdict-conflict machinery already records BOTH readings per cycle: months of (auditor narrative, deterministic gate) pairs sit in dossiers/audit-fail-reason artifacts. One Go tool computes the auditor's empirical sensitivity/specificity (how often narrative=PASS while a gate was red; narrative=FAIL while gates green) — if narrative-WARN-under-gate-FAIL dominates (observed repeatedly in batches 18-20), the auditor persona's WARN rubric needs tightening, evidence-first.
